content.value: Primary reading: Rozanski and Woods, Chapters 16-17. Supplemental: C4 context and container diagrams. This unit focuses on context viewpoint.

The context viewpoint documents the system in its environment. It clarifies users, external systems, interfaces, data flows, responsibilities, constraints, and assumptions that define the system boundary.
A context view is often the most useful first architecture artifact because it aligns people before implementation details distract the conversation.
Studio: revise a context diagram by adding missing actors, external data owners, and operational dependencies.

concepts.name: Context viewpoint
concepts.description: A viewpoint focused on the system boundary, external actors, external systems, and environmental interactions.

concepts.name: Actor
concepts.description: A person, role, organization, or system that interacts with the system from outside its boundary.

concepts.name: External interface
concepts.description: A boundary where the system communicates with another system, person, device, or service.

concepts.name: Context diagram
concepts.description: A model showing the system of interest, external actors, external systems, and relationships among them.
